sources.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
sources.design: Controlled interface ablations; fixed GPT-4 Turbo snapshot in SWE-bench Lite.
sources.cohort: 300 Lite instances; full SWE-bench separate. Shell baseline with/without demonstration differs.
sources.supports: 18% vs 11% with demonstration; 100-line viewer and last-five observations ablations.
sources.limitations: Model/demonstration/budget and full/Lite cohorts cannot be conflated.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.cohort: Multi-document QA and key-value retrieval in historical model cohort.
sources.supports: Relevant-position sensitivity within evaluated tasks.
sources.limitations: No universal 2026 token threshold; retrieval tasks are not repository repairs.

sources.title: RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
sources.cohort: Version 2: ten models, thirteen representative tasks.
sources.supports: Simple needle retrieval differs from tracing/aggregation.
sources.limitations: Later repository cohort is different; not current model leaderboard.

sources.title: NoLiMa: Long-Context Evaluation Beyond Literal Matching
sources.cohort: Twelve models; lengths 250 to 32k.
sources.supports: Ten models at 32k fall to half or less of short-length baseline.
sources.limitations: Minimal lexical overlap changes task difficulty; not universal software-context capacity.

sources.title: Context Rot: How Increasing Input Tokens Impacts LLM Performance
sources.design: Company technical report with empirical experiments.
sources.cohort: Eighteen model pool; not every model in every experiment.
sources.supports: Nonuniform long-context use under varied tasks and distractors.
sources.limitations: Provider/model/context-budget selection; company report, no causal claim about DeepSeek Code.

sources.title: Effective Context Engineering for AI Agents
sources.cohort: Architectural guidance rather than fixed-model code benchmark.
sources.supports: Progressive retrieval, concise sufficient context, state management.
sources.limitations: No optimum token count measured for DeepSeek Code.

sources.title: Introducing Advanced Tool Use on the Claude Developer Platform
sources.cohort: Opus 4 and Opus 4.5 reported internal evaluations.
sources.supports: 49 to 74 and 79.5 to 88.1 with Tool Search reported; extra discovery step.
sources.limitations: Private task/protocol details limit independent causal audit and transfer.

sources.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
sources.cohort: 500 questions; main GPT-4o/Llama 3.1 cohort.
sources.supports: Extraction, multi-session/temporal reasoning, updates, abstention; indexing/retrieval/reading.
sources.limitations: Memory benchmark does not directly estimate coding success or current product memory.

sources.title: Lost in Compaction: Evaluating Side-Constraint Loss under Context Compaction
sources.read_sections: Table 2; default setting; Appendix B.4 and G
sources.cohort: 100k main conditions across three scenarios; GPT-5.4-mini separate 220k subset.
sources.supports: 17% aggregate retention reported; substantial condition variation; retention vs compliance distinct.
sources.limitations: Preliminary; judge-based metrics; 220k model condition has fewer trials and is not matched to 100k.

sources.title: Compaction as Epistemic Failure: How Agentic LLM Tools Fabricate Confirmed Results from Killed Processes
sources.design: Single documented case and proposed mechanism.
sources.cohort: Claude Code on Windows; partial output and exit 143.
sources.supports: Printed output can be promoted to claimed completed/persisted result in a summary.
sources.limitations: Single instance, not population failure frequency or causal superiority of another harness.

sources.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
sources.cohort: Knowledge and interactive task domains.
sources.supports: Adapt trajectories using environmental feedback.
sources.limitations: Not proof that lengthy planning/personas improve repository repair; no private reasoning collection.

sources.title: Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents
sources.read_sections: Table 1; repair sampling and filtering ablations
sources.cohort: 300 SWE-bench Lite instances; GPT-4o; multiple candidates/selectors.
sources.supports: 27.33% result from simple pipeline in that cohort.
sources.limitations: Comparison with GPT-4 Turbo SWE-agent confounds model, sampling, and selection.

sources.title: How We Built Our Multi-Agent Research System
sources.cohort: Opus 4 leader/Sonnet 4 workers vs single Opus 4; internal research evaluation.
sources.supports: 90.2% reported gain; approximate 15x chat tokens; coding coupling caution.
sources.limitations: Models and aggregate compute differ; not same-model budget-matched coding causal evidence.

sources.title: RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs with Preference Data
sources.cohort: Strong/weak model response routing; benchmark tasks.
sources.supports: Quality/cost tradeoff routing is feasible in evaluated domain.
sources.limitations: No automatic transfer to stateful coding trajectories or arbitrary model pools.

sources.title: Introducing SWE-bench Verified
sources.cohort: 500 reviewed tasks; GPT-4o-2024-05-13 reported.
sources.supports: Fail-to-pass plus pass-to-pass; 16 vs 33.2 changes dataset.
sources.limitations: Original/Verified score difference is not causal harness improvement.

sources.title: Why SWE-bench Verified No Longer Measures Frontier Coding Capabilities
sources.design: Company audit with human review and contamination analysis.
sources.cohort: 138 selected tasks not consistently solved by o3 over 64 runs.
sources.supports: 59.4% in selected audit cohort; OpenAI stopped reporting Verified and recommends Pro.
sources.limitations: Selected-hard-case percentage cannot be extrapolated to all 500 tasks.

sources.title: SWE-bench Pro: Can AI Agents Solve Long-Horizon Software Engineering Tasks?
sources.design: Human-verified benchmark construction and unified-scaffold model evaluation.
sources.read_sections: Dataset overview; public set; experimental setup
sources.cohort: 1865 total tasks, 41 repos, 731 public in v1.
sources.supports: Public/held-out/commercial splits and human augmented contracts.
sources.limitations: Below-25% historical result not current ranking; public/copyleft does not prove uncontaminated.

sources.title: Terminal-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks in Command Line Interfaces
sources.design: Empirical agent/model benchmark and task verification.
sources.cohort: Text announces 89; Table 1 totals and Table 2 caption mention 74.
sources.supports: Tasks include container/instruction/tests/oracle; Terminus 2 is terminal agent; Harbor infra.
sources.limitations: Unreconciled 74/89 cohort inconsistency; same-model scaffold score differences not automatically significant.

sources.title: Harbor Documentation
sources.cohort: Infrastructure/framework documentation.
sources.supports: Framework for containerized task-agent evaluation.
sources.limitations: No new local implementation; GitHub README read returned 403.

sources.title: BFCL V4: Web Search and Holistic Agentic Evaluation
sources.cohort: V4 weighted categories, web search/memory/format sensitivity.
sources.supports: Overall score is category-weighted and differs from coding issue resolution.
sources.limitations: Version and FC/prompt mode must be controlled; not all items equally weighted.

sources.title: Tau-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
sources.cohort: Retail and airline; sampling of agent/user; historical cohort.
sources.supports: pass@k any-success vs pass^k all-success; user model part of setup.
sources.limitations: Not same task/denominator as SWE-bench or CLI fixing; simulated-user variance.

sources.title: Engineering Pitfalls in AI Coding Tools: An Empirical Study of Bugs in Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI
sources.design: Observational manually coded public bug reports.
sources.cohort: More than 3.8k reports closed by 2025-12-12 in three tools.
sources.supports: Tool invocation, execution, configuration/integration defects are relevant classes.
sources.limitations: Reported/closed issue frequencies do not estimate per-user incidence or compare product quality causally.

sources.title: Demystifying Evals for AI Agents
sources.read_sections: Task quality; isolated trials; graders and calibration
sources.cohort: Architecture guidance and examples.
sources.supports: Deterministic grading where appropriate; human calibration; clean environments.
sources.limitations: Guidance, not measured gains of local agent; grader anecdotes not causal coding benchmark.
